name: rank-in-maps
description: Portable Rank-in-Maps skills and MCP access for evidence-grounded local SEO workflows.

interface.longDescription: Local SEO Evidence Optimization and actions. Rank-in-Maps helps local business owners use saved audits, business facts and Local SEO guidance. Connect your RIM account, choose a business you can access, inspect recorded findings and draft useful next actions. Save and read back drafts in your RIM workspace, or use packaged skills to create business files in a destination you authorize. Missing or stale evidence stays explicit. Changes to a public business profile require your approval; connecting the plugin does not publish anything. Available operations depend on your existing account permissions and entitlements.
defaultPrompt: Start with Rank-in-Maps and show the next step for my account.
Explain my saved audit findings and the most useful next actions.
Read my saved business facts and show what is confirmed or still unknown.
